race.comment: UNLEESHING (16) has impressed in her two runs back and like the way she savaged the line out wide when second to Night Agent over 1400m at this track in weaker class. Ready for this trip and further on the limit and expect to see her a touch closer in the run today. Leading player. KNOBELAS (10) got a much better set-up second up and ran accordingly with a fast finishing second to Declichy Boulevard over 1600m at this track. Tempo suits and has solid top three claims. THE MONA LISA (9) iron mare who showed plenty of grit when holding on to score in a tight finish over 1600m at this track from the sticky gate. That form has been franked and regular rider hops back aboard. Respect. ZAPHOD (5) underrated gelding who can pull out a big run fresh if they overdo it up front. Wasn't knocked about in the two trials and goes into the exotics. CHISPA (18) stakes placed mare with a solid second up record. Gets in light and worth thought. The chances don't end there.
